summary: Parked-up kerb backing onto trees and a car park, but very steep.

best_section.where: Ryans Road west kerb, beside the treed bank and car park

drivers.seclusion: Kerb backs onto trees and a commercial car park; nearest dwellings are 12-13 m (Wrestpoint, a detached house) at the start and about 20 m at the far end.
drivers.access_and_room: Several cars parked along this kerb, so room to stop is fine.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with a lane each way.
drivers.convention: Cars park here and no parking signs are mapped.

sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the west side; open to the afternoon sun over the road.
